LanguageData.MF_Extras_RemembranceHint: Up to 5 actual photos are chosen by event type and time between moments. Press play to view each for 12 seconds. Your game speed stays yours.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_NoRemembrance: There are no photos to look back on yet.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_RefreshFolder: Look through the photo folder again
LanguageData.MF_Extras_ScanHint: Compare this colony's folder with the current save's photo list. Preview photos and import only those you check. Externally changed images are copied into new edited versions; originals are never removed or overwritten. For older photos the baseline is their first observed file state, so changes made before then cannot be identified.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_OtherDay: Photo absent from the current save's list
LanguageData.MF_Extras_ChangedImage: Externally changed image · import as new edit
LanguageData.MF_Extras_KnownHistory: This mod previously stored photo information. It cannot tell why the current save lacks this photo or whether it belongs to another timeline.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_UncertainHistory: The capture date and event cannot be verified. Any information recovered from a filename is a clue, not confirmed history.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_NoCandidates: There are no photos to import. Original files and existing records remain stored.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_SelectPreview: Click a photo on the left to preview it.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_ImportUnavailable: This photo cannot be imported into the current colony.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_ImageTooLarge: Photos can be up to 64MB and 8192px on each side. The original was not changed.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_ImageChanged: The file changed while you were reviewing it. Read again and select it anew.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_InvalidPng: The PNG could not be read. Check that it opens in an image editor. The original was not changed.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_ImportedNote: A photo explicitly imported by the user; its event cannot be verified in the current save.
LanguageData.MF_Extras_EventPeople: People in the event at that time: {0}
